info.title: FYRIRHYGGJA API
info.description: REST API for FYRIRHYGGJA, a bilingual (EN/IS) digital legacy-planning app. All authenticated endpoints use a Laravel Passport bearer token obtained from /api/v1/auth/register or /api/v1/auth/verify-otp.
